label: 01 / INTENT
detail: A human sets the goal and its boundaries.

label: 02 / PROPOSE
detail: Translate the goal into a proposal that can be challenged.

label: 03 / BUILD
detail: The builder turns the proposal into observable behavior.

label: 05 / DISSENT
detail: An objection returns to the proposal; it is not erased.

label: 06 / REVISE
detail: A revised proposal becomes a new implementation.

label: 07 / OBSERVE
detail: Runtime consequences return to the original intent.

label: 08 / VERIFY
detail: Review checks evidence for the current revision.

label: 09 / HUMAN DECISION
detail: The human may accept for now. New evidence can reopen the work.
